name: RADAR Challenge 2026 Dataset
description: RADAR Challenge 2026 Dataset============================ Robust Audio Deepfake Recognition under Media Transformations The RADAR Challenge 2026 is an APSIPA Grand Challenge on robust audiodeepfake detection under realistic media conditions. The task is to classify aspeech recording as bonafide (real) or spoofed (synthetic) after unknown mediatransformations. These may include codec compression, resampling, backgroundnoise, music mixing, room effects, peak-level adjustment, fades, silencetrimming, zero padding, dynamic-range compression, and bandwidth limitation.
